en: Believe me, I've seen some things.
Sometimes, you gotta go to extremes to help your friends.
If I'm not dealing with one type of patron, I'm dealing with another!
They don't need a bouncer when I'm tending bar!
Don't you worry, I got you.
You're one of my regulars, aren't you?
It's so nice to know that my years of antisocial behavior can be put to good use.

I got work to do anyway.
If you need a drink after the ritual, you know where to find me.

I think I'm just gonna sit this one out.
I ain't about that life anymore.
The old me would have jumped at the chance, but I'm wiser now.

We're not. I just, um... I just wanted to make sure she's doin' okay.

You friends with every bartender in Manhattan?

Let's just say I'm... glad you're on my side.
I'd buy you a drink when this is all over, but...

Sure. We survive this, I figure I owe you one.

Not my first time lighting things on fire.
Is it true you once kicked Mina Ha out of your bar?
She tried to use a fake.

She tried. But ain't no amount of money worth risking Jezebel's getting shut down.
God, I would have loved to see her face.
Not gonna lie... it was satisfying.
You know, there's rumors about you.
Yeah. Supposedly you're with the mob.

I dunno if I'd trust the Blackmore Academy rumor mill.
Don't know if I'd trust what she has to say either.
Hey, Graves. I'm not gonna tell you how to live your life. 'Cause lord knows you don't wanna hear it...

Look. When I was around your age, I needed help. And someone gave it to me. It changed my life. And I just wanted you to know that... I'm willing to pay it forward.

I know ma'am, they won't be.

Well... he'd do the same for me.
Bet you had quite the life before you became a bartender?

And this other time there was this dad and-
